---
name: Rule proposal
about: Propose a sourced, scoped rule with observable test cases
---

## Problem and applicability

Describe the owner module, proposed scope, requirement type, primary source and section, dates, and affected content.

## Evidence and tests

Describe passing, failing, boundary, and non-applicable cases, expected evidence, and false-positive risks.

## Human-review boundary

Explain what automation cannot conclude and any decisions needed before implementation.
